{{See also|Romero and Juliette}}

'''Romero and Juliette Quest Items''' are quest items obtained from [[Romero and Juliette]] quest. Players have to obtain them from [[Romero]] by bringing him the correct items, and then bring the quest items to [[Juliette]] for rewards.

== Trivia ==
* If lost, the quest items can be purchased from [[Rusty]] for {{c|100k}}.
* Yellow Rocks can alternatively be obtained from trees around the cave during the quest.
* The Solved Rubix Prism references popular puzzle toys Rubik's Cubes.
